---
id: am-share-link
title: Sharing a link
category: After a meeting
keywords: [share link, share meeting, link expires, revoke, stop sharing, include audio, include photos, include report, web page, recipient, imessage]
screen: review/meeting
---

⋯ menu > **Share Meeting**. It's only in the menu when you're signed in, because the link is created on Shoulder Surf's servers.

**What you choose.** Five switches, all on by default: Include queries & chat, the meeting report, AI-generated files, the photos, the audio. The transcript always goes; the sheet says so. Audio adds about 4 KB per second of recording, so an hour is around 15 MB.

**How long it lives.** "Link expires after": 1, 7, 30, 90 or 365 days. The default is 30.

**Language.** "Recorded in" and "Send in." Pick a different language and the transcript, summary, report and answers are translated before the link is made. Audio stays as recorded.

**Before you send.** The sheet reminds you: anyone with the link can open it, no sign-in; the first line of the summary shows in message previews; revoking can't recall a preview a chat app already cached.

**No report yet?** The sheet says so and offers "Create the report first," because a recipient without the app sees the report page.

**What the recipient gets.** With Shoulder Surf installed, tapping the link downloads the meeting (no account needed) and shows a preview card: "Shared with you, from <name>," with "Add to My Library." It becomes a copy in their Review with a "Shared by" badge; they can read it, translate it, and, if they want, add it to their own Memory. Without the app, they get a web page with the report.

**Revoking.** ⋯ menu > Stop Sharing Link. The link stops working for anyone who opens it from then on. Already-delivered copies and cached previews can't be taken back.

**In Messages.** Shared meetings appear in the Shoulder Surf iMessage app as cards. Only meetings that already have a link show there.

The link is free on every plan.
